nary_nodes.label: Hantavirus outbreak on MV Hondius
evidence: So far, three people have died, with several others taken ill, after a hantavirus outbreak aboard the cruise ship MV Hondius.
A Dutch couple, who were the first to become ill and later died, had been visiting South America before departing on the ship from Argentina's southernmost town, Ushuaia, in late March.
The WHO have confirmed two of the deaths were from the virus, with the other 'probable' at this stage.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event representing the spread and impact of a virus within a specific population or location.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event class captures virus outbreaks; 'DeliveryEvent' and others are irrelevant.

nary_nodes.label: WHO confirms two deaths from hantavirus
evidence: The World Health Organization (WHO) have confirmed two of the deaths were from the virus, with the other 'probable' at this stage.

nary_nodes.label: WHO recommends 42-day quarantine for high-risk contacts
evidence: The WHO recommends that 'high-risk contacts' of confirmed cases quarantine for '42 days following last exposure.'

nary_nodes.label: Hantavirus not comparable to COVID-19
evidence: 'I understand people have a lot of anxiety, having experienced the [COVID-19] pandemic, but this is a very different virus and a different set of circumstances,' she added.

nary_nodes.label: 2018-19 Andes strain outbreak in Argentina
evidence: The most notable recent outbreak of the Andes strain was in Argentina in 2018-19. Three people who came into contact with infected rodents spread hantavirus to 34 others. In total, 11 people died.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event representing the spread and impact of a virus within a specific population or location.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event class captures virus outbreaks; 'DeliveryEvent' and others are irrelevant.

nary_nodes.label: WHO recommends passive self-monitoring for low-risk contacts
evidence: Those who had less contact with an ill patient should only 'undertake passive self-monitoring and seek medical evaluation if symptoms occur.'

nary_nodes.label: Passengers evacuated from MV Hondius to respective countries
evidence: With the ship now docked, passengers are being returned to their countries of residence.
Four other German nationals landed in Frankfurt on Monday, with asymptomatic patients being sent either to hospital or into self-isolation after medical checks, depending on circumstances.
14 Spanish nationals flew to Madrid on Sunday and will be isolated at a hospital in the capital.
Turkish, Belgian, Greek, British and Argentinian passengers are traveling to medical facilities after socially-distant flights on Sunday.
The last evacuation flight was expected to leave for the Netherlands on Monday afternoon.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where individuals are removed from a location for safety reasons, such as passengers from a ship.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event class fits evacuations; 'DeliveryEvent' and user interactions are unrelated.

nary_nodes.label: Andes strain requires close contact for transmission
evidence: Close, prolonged contact, such as the conditions found on a cruise ship, is usually required to transmit the virus in this way.

nary_nodes.label: 2018-19 outbreak traced to birthday party
evidence: Contact tracing and isolation were established relatively quickly after the discovery of the virus, with the first transmission traced to a birthday party.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event representing the spread of a virus from a source to new hosts or locations.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event class captures virus transmission; 'SocialEvent' and others are mismatched.

nary_nodes.label: 17 American passengers tested for hantavirus
evidence: One of the 17 American passengers returned a 'weak positive' test in Cape Verde, according to the US Department of Health and Human Services, who will do further tests.

nary_nodes.label: ECDPD emphasizes passenger movement tracking for containment
evidence: The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDPD), a European Union medical authority, says tracing passengers' movements before and after boarding the ship is critical to preventing the virus from spreading.
